_comment: FTSE 250 index level at the most recent completed London close. The FTSE 250 is a cleaner read on the domestic UK economy than the FTSE 100 (which is dominated by global commodity and pharma names). LSEG does not expose a free index-level JSON feed; the number is transcribed from the Yahoo Finance ^FTMC daily chart close. The adapter's freshness guard rejects fixtures older than 14 days so a missed refresh surfaces in the ingest audit. 2026-10-28 refresh: completed 27 October session close was 24,716.400390625, rounded to one decimal (24,716.4), from Yahoo Finance ^FTMC daily chart. The 28 October bar was still in progress before the 16:30 London close and is not used. The observed_at is 16:30 GMT = 16:30 UTC after the 25 October clock change. Live path tries EODHD FTMC.INDX then Yahoo ^FTMC, skipping any in-progress daily bar until 16:35 Europe/London. TODO(source): an authorised LSEG index-licence vendor would let us drop this fixture.
release_schedule: Every London trading day at ~16:30; editorial fixture refreshed weekly.
